requirements.title: ATOMIC_INT_KIND is a default integer scalar named constant
requirements.source: S16.10.2.2 p1 constant form; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF472.
requirements.definition: ATOMIC_INT_KIND is a default integer scalar constant in ISO_FORTRAN_ENV.

pending.atomic_int_kind-default-integer-scalar: Import ATOMIC_INT_KIND from ISO_FORTRAN_ENV, assign it to a default integer scalar initialized to -777, assert KIND(ATOMIC_INT_KIND) equals KIND(0) and RANK(ATOMIC_INT_KIND) equals 0; mutate the imported name to a sibling constant.

requirements.title: ATOMIC_INT_KIND names the integer kind for atomic operations
requirements.source: S16.10.2.2 p1 atomic-operation kind value; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023, physical PDF472.
requirements.definition: The value of ATOMIC_INT_KIND is the kind type parameter value of integer variables for which the processor supports atomic operations specified by atomic subroutines.
